jd:
Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Brackenridge Cloud

About the role
Brackenridge runs a multi-tenant platform for event ticketing. As a staff engineer you will set reliability direction across teams. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Define reliability targets and error budgets
- Design and review infrastructure changes
- Lead incident response and reviews

Requirements
- Kubernetes in production at scale
- Terraform
- Prometheus and observability design
- Advanced Linux administration
- Incident command and on-call leadership
- Go programming

Nice to have
- Service mesh experience
- Chaos engineering

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks

qa.question: Does the candidate cover out-of-hours support?
qa.expected_answer: Yes, one week in six on the after-hours phone line.
supporting: Cover the after-hours phone line one week in six

qa.question: What Linux experience does the candidate have?
qa.expected_answer: An occasional Ubuntu file server for the design team.
supporting: Set up a small Ubuntu file server for the design team

qa.question: Has the candidate led incident response for a production platform?
qa.expected_answer: No: the resume only shows logging helpdesk incidents, not leading production incident response.

notes: Near-miss vocabulary (after-hours phone line, Ubuntu, incident log) tempts a system into crediting on-call and Linux fully. Labels give partial only, and the score is still poor. Tests seniority-awareness.
